notes.title: Working Towards Release
notes.notes:
Greetings fellow chaotic golf enjoyers! We have been silent on demo updates while getting the full version ready for our release on 3 November. While not giving away too much, here's a quick update on what we have been cooking up behind the scenes. Stay tuned for upcoming news on our demo very very soon.


More Content!
Brand new emotes!

Interesting new minigames!

More player colors, trails and hats!

A ton of Steam achievements!

And much, much more!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45569046/45963f2329fd4c37848e293a198ee2e81558f3a1.jpg"]


General Improvements
A completely revamped appearance menu for ultimate customization.

Drastically improved BOT behavior.

Emote rendering has been improved to be visually clearer and not hide player names.

Improved many existing minigame level layouts.

Bug fixes, bug fixes and more bug fixes.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45569046/743acef687f5246a5e9f830930af3ebafb12206b.png"]

While we're confident that our demo is just about ready, we will continue to add content, fix bugs and polish off the experience to give your friendships the worst possible chance of surviving a round of Super Serious Golf.

notes.title: Demo Version 0.966
notes.notes:
Major Changes
Emote selection added to the appearance menu.

Color selection added to the appearance menu.

New King of the Hill Map.

Players disconnecting or leaving a match will be replaced with bots.

New Powerup: C4.

Whack-A-Crate now has golden and explosive crates to watch out for.

Added advanced match settings including: Bot difficulty, hit power, movement speed, disable jump.


Minor Fixes and Changes
Improved bot behaviour.

Fixed a bug where players could be eliminated twice in a row.

Added extra VFX to epic and legendary hats.

Improved player name rendering.

Added new emotes.

Fixed a bug where highlighted important players would not show while in rock form.

Fixed a bug where powerups would not be removed on elimination.

Improved host start procedure.
